lines.t: the hoodies are pre-order only. sizes are limited.
that's all the selling i'm doing today.
why is my name moth?
wow. i actually don't remember.
oh! i remember why i'm called moth.
i always wear my goggles. i ride my scooter to work.
my bestie said i look like a moth in them. pretty sure that was it.
yeah. that was it.
oh, this necklace? i make my own jewelry. i made this.
it's the candy carnage deadheart.
i showed the owner. he seemed to like it, but he's not sure it'd sell.
you should tell him you like it too. maybe he'll start selling them?
check the hood lining on the hoodies. skulls, brass knuckles.
nobody sees it but you'll know. that's the best kind of detail.
i wear a medium. i buy a large.
that's my whole system. it's never let me down.
wash inside out, cold, hang dry. i tell everyone.
nobody listens. eventually their prints crack.
i'm not saying i told you. i'm saying i tell everyone.
the planes tee wraps all the way around the side.
very 2000s post hardcore. i heard the design was actually from 2006.
black goes with black.
only fashion advice i have. it's never failed.
raspberry rapture and nuclear nectar.
i can't pick. i've been trying since monday.
the giraffe on the ghouls tee looks like he's seen things.
he has. he worked at a toy store.
people keep calling me an elder emo. i prefer scenior citizen.
i didn’t spend three hours teasing my hair to have my scene credentials erased.
people ask if the neon one glows in the dark.
it doesn't. it just looks like it should. now i kinda wish it did...
i layer a hoodie over a band tee over a long sleeve.
in arizona. i know. i don't want to talk about it.
went to warped tour every summer.
sunburned, dehydrated, lost a shoe once. best days of my life. now its too expensive :(
shows are so expensive now.
forty dollar ticket, sixty dollars in fees.
thanks a lot, ticketmaster. really.
i stand in the back at shows.
that's where the good people are. and the exit.
my headphones only work on one side.
i call it mono. it's a choice...ok it's not a choice.
every mall used to have a store like this.
now there's only this one. you're in it. congrats.
my bestie and i still make burned cds.
she labels them in sharpie. no tracklist. it's a surprise every time.
the owner picks the music.
i turn it up when he's not looking.
slow day.
it's always a slow day. i like it like that.
the stockroom light keeps buzzing.
i don't go back there after close. no reason.
have you seen the shirt packaging? looks just like a candy wrapper
just dont eat whats inside...thatd be awkward...
the owner named the pink one raspberry rapture.
i wanted to call it fuschia frenzy. i lost that vote. it was a vote of one. his. guess mine didnt count *shrugs*
nuclear nectar looks different under every light.
under the bathroom light here it looks actually radioactive. which, fair.
the deadheart is half heart, half ribcage.
love and death...in love and death...oh man i need to listen to the used again
if you're between sizes, size up.
hoodies are for disappearing into. at least for me
the ghouls tee goes so hard with plaid pants.
trust me. i'm a professional. i work retail.
i keep a lint roller at the counter for emergencies.
every day is an emergency. i wear black. and have 4 cats. lifes a struggle
lining up the planes print across the seams took forever.
wonder why the owner didnt use the tees with no side seam??
my first show i spent two hours doing my hair just to sweat it flat during the opening band.
nobody noticed. everyone was busy getting kicked in the face.
i still have my old flip phone. no service.
i just like using it to take mirror selfies straight from 2008
myspace top 8 ruined so many friendships.
i was number three on a lot of lists. never number one. it's fine. it's been 15 years. it's fine.
i did my eyeliner on the city bus for four years.
i could do a wing during an earthquake. it's my only real skill.
the mall stores used to smell like that one incense.
i think about it more than i think about most people.
i went to a show where the singer jumped off the balcony into the crowd.
i caught a shoe. not his. someone else's. i still have it.
the owner answers the phone 'candy carnage' like it's the title of a horror movie.
every single time. i love him for it. don't tell him.
my scooter's parked out back. it's purple.
it makes a noise like a sad goose. i named her gertrude.
i'm supposed to refold the tees every hour.
i refold them every hour-ish. the ish is doing a lot of work.
the bathroom light flickers sometimes.
don't worry about it. it's a bathroom light. they do that.
someone keeps leaving empty energy drink cans by the back door.
not mine. ill have a monster when im feelin sentimental but im more of a coffee person in my old age
take your time. or don't.
i'm still here. i work here.
*hums Sugar Rush*
did you fall asleep?
no rush. i'm getting paid either way.
raspberry rapture. pre-order, limited sizes. the inside of the hood is the best part.
nuclear nectar. same deal as the pink one. this green doesn't exist in nature. i checked.
ghouls r us. the giraffe's been through some stuff. respect him.
the deadheart, but loud. people will see you from the parking lot.
deadheart on black. goes with everything you own. which is black.
the planes go down the side and around the back. tap back. they're still going.
same planes, black tee. these ones fly at night.
